notice: Provisional collection. Records identify reported findings and their limits. The Commons has not independently verified the underlying claims; inclusion is not endorsement.

evidence.title: Microsoft reports malicious startup files in LiteLLM artifacts executed without importing LiteLLM.
evidence.observation: Microsoft reports malicious startup files in LiteLLM artifacts executed without importing LiteLLM. The maintainer reports the official source tag did not contain those files. A source-tag check therefore cannot establish the distributed artifact’s integrity.

source_locations.SRC-025: Attack overview; Compromised package distribution and automatic payload execution; Advanced hunting
source_locations.SRC-026: Attack-chain report; companion incident notice, official source tag versus compromised artifacts

evidence.limitations: Microsoft did not independently establish initial credential theft. Startup alone does not establish completed collection or upload; a missing marker is inconclusive. Optional Unix remote execution was not confirmed. No evidence here establishes autonomous AI causation of the compromise.
evidence.open_questions: Generalization outside inspected settings and completeness/authenticity of underlying traces remain unestablished by the Commons.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed bounded finding; publication inclusion does not certify truth or completeness. Microsoft artifact/endpoint analysis and maintainer upstream account concern one incident with partly different evidential scopes; not blanket independent corroboration. No matching source or underlying case found among baseline v0.4.1 SRC-001–018 / CASE-001–017; recurring report mentions merge into this candidate, not corroboration.
evidence.dispute_status: Bounded correction checks; known limitations retained, no absence guarantee
evidence.verification_status: Not independently verified by the Commons

terms.name: Assurance
terms.definition: Evidence-supported confidence that specified properties or outcomes will hold under stated objectives, operating conditions, and assumptions. Assurance has a defined scope and can lose relevance when those conditions change.

terms.name: Investigative indicator
terms.definition: An observed characteristic or combination of signals that provides a reason to investigate a possible event, mechanism, or hidden relationship without establishing that it occurred.

terms.name: Reference environment integrity
terms.definition: The reliability, provenance, completeness, and resistance to manipulation of information used to make operational or assurance judgments, including documents, logs, telemetry, evidence, and monitoring outputs.
